part.name: OD-G04_brewing-gasket-support
part.what_it_is: Brew-group gasket support disc: a moulded plastic cup with a flat back face, back bead and conical centre recess; on the front a stepped hub tube, six radial ribs, two ring-rib arcs, four screw bosses and two boss webs; an outer flange with a beaded gasket lip and three bayonet tabs at equal pitch.

method_summary: Intake: hashed the full-resolution scan, decimated a working copy, and aligned it to a datum frame (plate back face = z 0, cup outer wall axis = +Z, bayonet tab 1 toward +X).
Measure: derived every parameter from the scan (scan-only, no calipers; four catalogue photos for feature identification), with probe scripts and figures kept in measure/figures.
Build: build123d model.py built one revolve profile plus tabs, ribs, ring arcs, bosses, webs and cut tools from params.json and exported datum-frame and scan-frame STEP.
Verify: an independent agent re-registered the scan by its own ICP and graded two-way full-resolution deviation against the baseline-skill plastic band.
Deliver: packaged the owner-accepted BAND_NOT_MET result with a fresh-process reproducibility check and a delivery zip.

limitations.text: Tier-1 not run: no caliper sheet was supplied (scan-only run, DECISIONS.md MEASUREMENTS); no Tier-1 dimension is verified.
limitations.evidence: qa/gate.json#limitations; qa/gate.json#auto_limitations: no Tier-1 (no calipers run); DECISIONS.md

limitations.text: Absolute scale not caliper-verified (CHK-SCALE not run; units assumed mm).

The gated scan-to-CAD p95 ({{gate:deviation.scan_to_cad.p95}} mm) comes from the verifier's default ICP, which paired faces across the thin walls and shifted the CAD along z; the datum-frame grade and a diagnostic ICP with a tighter correspondence distance both stay inside the p95 band (qa/deviation_datum.json, qa/diagnostic/). The gate number is reported as graded.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a skill decision on the ICP correspondence distance for thin-walled parts, then re-run verify

limitations.text: CAD-to-scan observable miss ({{gate:deviation.cad_to_scan_observable.p95}} / {{gate:deviation.cad_to_scan_observable.max}} mm) is driven by surfaces the scanner never reached (front cavity: plate underside outside the scanned sector, rib sides, hub interior; outer-wall gap); the observability test counts them as observable. The model extrapolates those regions from the scanned ones.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a rescan covering the front cavity and the outer wall gap

limitations.text: Verify ran the observability step through a call wrapper with a smaller ray chunk to avoid running out of memory (identical per-ray results; no skill script edited).
limitations.rerun_trigger: none needed unless the skill changes the ray engine

limitations.text: Scan-to-CAD max ({{gate:deviation.scan_to_cad.max}} mm) is three isolated scan points (no cluster): one on a bayonet-tab end corner, two at the cup-wall/flange root.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a caliper reading of the across-tabs dimension

limitations.text: Centre post outer radius ({{params:centre_post_R_out.value}} mm) is photo-inferred; the plate underside is scanned only in one sector and assumed planar elsewhere at plate_under_z.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a caliper reading of plate thickness or the centre post

limitations.text: Declared simplifications: equal tab heights (tab 1 measured lower), equal rib pitch (measured scatter kept in params), straight walls instead of mould draft, moulded text, ejector-pin marks and small rib/boss root fillets not modelled.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a functional fit issue on the tabs or a request for draft-exact geometry

limitations.text: The builder's own scan-to-CAD self-comparison that drove plan changes is a consistency check, not independent evidence (CHK-CIRCULAR); only the verifier's gate is evidence.

assumptions.text: Plate underside outside the scanned sector assumed planar at the scanned level; hub interior between the centre post and the hub bore closed at the plate underside.

not_fit_for: tooling, mould design or mating-interface manufacture until the tabs, flange, lip and plate thickness are calipered
tolerance-grade inspection: Tier-1 was not run and the scale is unverified
fit_for: form, visual and fit-check prototyping (e.g. 3D-printed replacement trials)
an editable parametric base: build/model.py driven by measure/params.json

repro_commands: cd build && python3 model.py --params ../measure/params.json --alignment ../intake/alignment.json --out . --part OD-G04_brewing-gasket-support --scripts <path to stl-re-rebuild-build123d/scripts>

feature_tree.feature: revolve profile: plate, bead, hub ring, cone, centre bore/post, stepped hub tube, cup wall, flange, lip
cut: counterbored boss holes + 4 back slots
